narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and explain the internet slang term 'Matcha Man' (抹茶男), a trend originating from Western Gen Z culture that satirizes men who perform feminism or intellectualism solely to attract women. It uses a combination of direct host address and relevant b-roll footage to define the term and explain why it has become a subject of ridicule.
